summary: Phase 3 testing: Home actions widget, Events/RSVP, Pulse Compare, CSV export. Backend fully passes (10/10). Frontend mostly works but Admin Panel is missing the 'Etkinlikler' tab entirely — a critical implementation gap.

ui_bugs.issue: Admin Panel is missing the 'Etkinlikler' (events) tab. TABS array only defines categories/announcements/pulse. EventsManager is referenced in JSX on line 44 (`{tab === 'events' && <EventsManager />}`) but is NEVER imported at the top — this would additionally throw a ReferenceError if the tab were somehow activated. Result: no admin-tab-events, add-event-btn, event-edit-<id>, event-del-<id> are reachable via the UI.

action_items: AdminPanel.js: add `{ key: 'events', label: 'Etkinlikler', icon: Calendar }` (or similar icon) to the TABS array so the 4th admin tab renders.
critical_code_review_comments: AdminPanel.js references <EventsManager/> without importing the component — dead-code that would crash if that tab were switched on.

AppContext role/currentEmployeeId are React-only state (no localStorage). Any hard-reload resets role to 'employee' and employee to first seed. Acceptable for mock role switcher but worth documenting.
PulseReport.exportCsv: File download is client-side Blob only — works but no server-side export endpoint (acceptable per spec).
Events feed doesn't sort by upcoming only (past events still visible if event_date < now). Consider filtering.

success_rate.frontend: ~85% — everything works except Admin Panel Etkinlikler tab entirely missing

test_credentials: None — mock role-switcher. Used Erol Taş (employee) + Selin Tekin (admin) via role toggle.
seed_data_creation: Created and cleaned up 1 test pulse (TEST_Zorunlu_Widget_Pulse) via API to verify actions widget rendering. Backend RSVP tests also create/delete temporary events (TEST_ prefixed).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend endpoints /api/events, /api/events/{id}/rsvp (upsert verified — no double count), /api/pulses/{id}/compare all pass automated pytest at /app/backend/tests/test_events_compare.py. Frontend HomePage actions widget, EventsFeed, EventDetail RSVP, PulseReport compare tab, CSV export all work in the browser. Only failure: AdminPanel.js is missing (a) import of EventsManager and (b) 'events' entry in TABS array — fix both to unblock the entire admin events CRUD flow.
rca_of_the_issue: AdminPanel.js was partially updated for phase 3: the JSX conditional `{tab === 'events' && <EventsManager />}` was added on line 44, but the corresponding TABS entry AND the import statement were never added. Users can never activate the events tab because there is no button rendering it, and if they could (e.g., via setTab), the app would throw ReferenceError: EventsManager is not defined.
